finding.title: The payment webhook can confirm a released hold
finding.explanation: onPaymentSucceeded books the slot for any hold it finds, released or not. A guest who pays after the hold expired gets a booking for a slot that may already be someone else's.
finding.reasoningSummary: The second head guarded it with `if (!hold || hold.releasedAt) return;`, and the reviewer verified that fixed. This head is back to `if (!hold) return;`, so the code that was fixed has returned.
finding.suggestedFix:
Skip a released hold, and refund its payment instead of booking:

if (!hold || hold.releasedAt) return refundLatePayment(event);
